Merge pull request #101 from johnnys66/master

Support for AIX 7.1 TL4.

BUILD: Add an --enable-man-pages configuration option

Resolves:
https://github.com/jhrozek/pam_hbac/issues/100

Adds a new config-time option --enable-man-pages. Man pages are enabled
by default, but when this option is set to --disable-man-pages, even
though a2x might be detected on the system, man pages will not be
generated.

LDAP: Only start SSL if TLS is not available

Resolves:
    https://github.com/jhrozek/pam_hbac/issues/97

On some systems, like Solaris 11, we got into a schizophrenic situation
where both the native Sun/Mozilla LDAP libraries were installed, but
also OpenLDAP, with the mozldap libraries being quite old.

During configure, we detected both, but during build-time we defined the
old SSL-only functions first but at the same time included the OpenLDAP
headers. This resulted in a compilation error like this:

hbac_ldap.Tpo -c src/pam_hbac_ldap.c  -fPIC -DPIC -o src/.libs/pam_hbac_ldap.o
src/pam_hbac_ldap.c: In function ‘secure_preinit’:
src/pam_hbac_ldap.c:462:5: error: implicit declaration of function ‘ldapssl_client_init’ [-Werror=implicit-function-declaration]
     ret = ldapssl_client_init(ssl_path, NULL);
     ^
src/pam_hbac_ldap.c: In function ‘start_ssl’:
src/pam_hbac_ldap.c:488:5: error: implicit declaration of function ‘ldapssl_install_routines’ [-Werror=implicit-function-declaration]
     ret = ldapssl_install_routines(ldap);
     ^
src/pam_hbac_ldap.c: At top level:
src/pam_hbac_ldap.c:476:12: warning: ‘start_ssl’ defined but not used [-Wunused-function]
 static int start_ssl(pam_handle_t *ph,
            ^
cc1: some warnings being treated as errors
*** Error code 1

TESTS: Do not set up SSL to work with older Python releases

Python < 2.7.10 doesn't have the SSLContext class at all, so in order to
avoid issues running CI on stock Ubuntu 14.04 (which is for some reason
still what both Travis and Semaphore use), disable SSL.

Merge pull request #95 from jhrozek/hpux

Hpux

build: Define _REENTRANT on HP-UX

The reentrant NSS interface is only available on HP-UX if the _REENTRANT
macro is defined. This patch adds a call to AC_CANONICAL_SYSTEM so that
the variables like target_os are defined. Then, if target_os contains
hpux or hp-ux, define the _REENTRANT macro

build: Add a --disable-ssl configuration option

On some platforms, the SSL support in the LDAP library might be flaky or
the admin might decide to just make the dependencies minimal. Since
pam_hbac only deals with authorization data, it is not strictly required
to maintain confidentiality.

However, we still default to SSL.

LDAP: SSL_PATH is a not a required option

Resolves:
    https://github.com/jhrozek/pam_hbac/issues/86

If libldap defaults can be used, just use them and don't force the admin
to specify more parameters than strictly necessary.

doc: Add the ignore_authinfo_unavail to FreeBSD and Solaris docs

Resolves:
    https://github.com/jhrozek/pam_hbac/issues/87

It is useful to include the ignore_authinfo_unavail option in the default
docs, otherwise even local users might be locked out in case the LDAP
server is not reachable.

LDAP: Don't specify timeout ourselves

Resolves:
    https://github.com/jhrozek/pam_hbac/issues/88

We tried to be too smart and ended up specifying too huge timeout.
The timeout is supposed to be seconds since the operation, not an
absolute time.

It's really better to not handle the timeout ourselves at all, but rely
on openldap defaults.
man: Fix a typo in the manpage
tests: Fix a compilation warning in pam-test-client.c

LDAP: Add a new option to disable SSL during searches

Add a new undocumented option "SECURE" which defaults to true. If this
option is set to "FALSE", StartTLS or SSL won't be even tried.

doc: Add README.md

If no README.md was provided in the docs, we would have displayed
README.FreeBSD when a user navigated to the doc/ subdir with a browser
simply because it would be lexicographically first..

config: Rename CA_CERT to SSL_PATH

Since we support NSS databases with certificates in addition to
certificate files, the option must be agnostic as well.
Improve Solaris documentation to include Omnios

Silence compilation warnings on Solaris

Resolves:
    https://github.com/jhrozek/pam_hbac/issues/76

On Solaris, pam_get_item returns "char *", but on Linux, the same
interface returns "const char **". Detect this during configure time and
either cast or discard const appropriatelly.

Provide compat definition of several OpenLDAP functions

Resolves:
    https://github.com/jhrozek/pam_hbac/issues/79

Some platforms (like Omnios) do not ship with OpenLDAP libraries at all,
but instead only use SunLDAP. And SunLDAP libraries do not provide
ldap_initialize() but only ldap_init(). Also, they don't provide the
modern functions to work with DNs like ldap_str2dn() or ldap_dnfree().
If these are not available, fall back to the deprecated functions like
ldap_explode_dn().

Also provides a unit tests that fakes a deprecated system to run the
existing dnparse-tests just with the compat implementation.
